purpose: Bound a canonical chart with a readable heading, description, and token-driven surface.
useWhen: a chart needs a titled surface in a public or application composition
avoidWhen: the chart is already inside a component that owns its surface
a raw SVG would be sufficient for a one-off illustration
accessibility: Provide a meaningful heading and keep the chart's accessible name connected to its data.
Preserve chart keyboard and tooltip semantics supplied by the chart contract.
responsive: Keeps chart content bounded and readable in narrow containers.
Allows the chart implementation to own its responsive plot geometry.
motion: Delegates data animation to the chart contract.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion through the composed chart.

api.name: description
api.description: Supporting context announced with the primary content.

visualization.intent: Bound a chart with a readable heading, description, and shared surface.
consumerOwns: heading, description, chart data, and actions
ten4sevenOwns: surface, measure, chart composition, and state presentation

useWhen: consumer-calculated data needs a bounded visual comparison or trend
a concise chart plus a textual summary improves a decision surface
avoidWhen: a table or list is the clearer primary representation
business formulas, fetching, or export authorization would be hidden in the renderer
adaptiveStrategy: reduce ticks and wrap or move the legend below on narrow surfaces
use native press/selection callouts rather than hover
ai.accessibilityAlternative: Expose an accessible name and concise data summary; provide a list or table alternative when point-level access matters.
